summary: OCHA records two Palestinians injured in separate settler vehicle-stoning incidents on Mar. 19 and Mar. 27. The Mar. 19 Al-Maarajat component is already canonical; the Mar. 27 OCHA component remains unidentified at event level.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; WAFA; PLO NAD daily reports; canonical Sheet reconciliation
resolution_notes: Correction to prior mapping: the Deir Istiya incident involving Muhammad Sami Muhammad Abu Rabi' is NOT the OCHA Mar. 27 vehicle-stoning component. NAD's 'March 27' daily report explicitly covers 08:00 Mar. 26 to 08:00 Mar. 27, and its 13:50 Deir Istiya entry therefore occurred on Mar. 26. OCHA's Mar. 27 stoning injury is described as on a road near Nablus or Ramallah, not Salfit. Mar. 19 Al-Maarajat remains deduplicated to ILPV-2023-0323. Preserve MAR23-015 as Unresolved for the still-unidentified OCHA Mar. 27 incident.
media_status: ILPV-2023-0323 has no exact incident media; no exact media recovered for the unresolved OCHA Mar. 27 component and no substitute imagery used.

summary: At 13:50 settlers near Deir Istiya threw stones at Palestinian vehicles, damaging a vehicle and injuring its driver, Muhammad Sami Muhammad Abu Rabi' of Balata camp, who was admitted to the government hospital in Nablus.
discovery_sources: PLO NAD Daily Situation Report titled March 27 2023 (reporting window 08:00 Mar. 26-08:00 Mar. 27); PSNA/Daily Blog reproductions; canonical Sheet dedupe check
resolution_notes: Split from the previously conflated MAR23-015 mapping. Date is now supported as Mar. 26 because the NAD report's explicit reporting window places the 13:50 event on Mar. 26; the report title is the following day's issue date, not the incident date. Canonical Sheet search found no Deir Istiya March 2023 duplicate. The event remains Unresolved because no independent exact-event corroboration or original/exact media was recovered; derivative reproductions do not count as independent corroboration.
